description: This file contains functions and types for gathering and reporting the status of a daemon process, including configuration resolution, port inspection, and RPC communication.

methods.name: loadGatewayProbeAuthModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports the gateway probe authentication module.

methods.name: loadDaemonInspectModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports the daemon inspect module.

methods.name: loadServiceAuditModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports the service audit module.

methods.name: loadGatewayTlsModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports the gateway TLS module.

methods.name: loadDaemonProbeModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports the daemon probe module.

methods.name: loadRestartHealthModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports the restart health module.

methods.name: resolveSnapshotRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Resolves runtime configuration from a config file snapshot.

methods.name: appendProbeNote
methods.description: Concatenates existing probe notes with additional info, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: loadDaemonConfigContext
methods.description: Loads and resolves the daemon's configuration context, including environment and config files.

methods.name: resolveGatewayStatusSummary
methods.description: Resolves the current status summary of the gateway, including port, bind mode, and probe URL.

methods.name: toPortStatusSummary
methods.description: Converts port diagnostics into a port status summary.

methods.name: inspectDaemonPortStatuses
methods.description: Inspects the port usage status for daemon and CLI ports.

methods.name: gatherDaemonStatus
methods.description: Gathers comprehensive status information about the daemon, including configuration, runtime, port usage, RPC, and health.

methods.name: renderPortDiagnosticsForCli
methods.description: Formats port diagnostics for CLI display based on daemon status.

methods.name: resolvePortListeningAddresses
methods.description: Extracts listening addresses from port listeners in daemon status.
